protocol.scope: Frozen features and diagnostic physical labels only. Same projection per dimension across all tasks/checkpoints. Capacity controls mitigate but do not eliminate differences between feature families.

checkpoints.scope: Frozen visual encoder, fixed train-standardized linear ridge, physical labels only for diagnostic probes. Full spatial features have greater readout capacity; RP64 controls dimension but is not a learned optimal compression. Low linear R2 does not prove absent nonlinear information.
